items.title_en: Google's DeepCrossAttention matches quality at up to 3x speed

The technique targets transformer efficiency, which lowers the cost of training and inference. The claim comes from the Hacker News discussion, and the underlying details are limited in the available text.
items.why_en: Faster transformer architectures directly reduce inference cost and latency for the LLM workloads you may deploy internally.

items.title: Revisiting LLMs as Context Engineers
items.snippet: As large language models (LLMs) are used in more and more new tasks, context engineering becomes a fundamental method to efficiently steer LLMs by constructing instruction prompts or metadata without intensive training. A growing number of LLM context engineering (LCE) approaches automate the task by casting the LLM itself as the engineer that draws generalizable instructions or experiences from offline trials as context. Although these methods resemble how humans learn from experiences, it remains unclear when and how LLMs can engineer effective context from data. To answer the question, we first establish a benchmark composed of datasets with different reasoning patterns. We compared diffe
items.title_ar: Revisiting LLMs as Context Engineers: متى يصيغ النموذج السياق بفعالية
items.summary_ar: تدرس الورقة قدرة LLMs على تصميم الـ context بأنفسهم عبر استخلاص instructions أو experiences عامة من offline trials، بدلاً من الاعتماد على تدريب مكثف. قدم الباحثون benchmark مبنياً على datasets بأنماط reasoning مختلفة، ثم قارنوا أساليب LCE لمعرفة متى تنتج context فعالاً.
items.why_ar: يفيد مباشرة في تحسين الـ prompts وبناء agents في POCs البنكية دون fine-tuning مكلف.
items.title_en: Revisiting LLMs as Context Engineers: When Models Engineer Their Own Context
items.summary_en: The paper examines whether LLMs can design their own context by distilling general instructions or experiences from offline trials, instead of relying on intensive training. The authors build a benchmark with datasets that have different reasoning patterns and compare LCE approaches to find when they produce effective context.
items.why_en: Directly useful for improving prompts and agent designs in banking POCs without costly fine-tuning.

items.title: Markdown Is Not a Firewall: four coding agents, one rules file, four boundaries
items.snippet: Teams put a one-page rules file in a repository and call it a control on coding agents. A registered study found agents rarely look up a repository's contribution rules. I asked the security question: what does a rules file do at a boundary, against a gate? I tested one 278-word rules file, with hypotheses and analysis code deposited first. Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI and OpenCode with DeepSeek worked through 20 small repositories with hidden tests, 12 for three of them. Three agents met four boundaries I built: a refused endpoint, a destructive shortcut, a planted instruction and a planted package. Permission prompts, each vendor's own control layer, were off by design. A gate in fro
items.title_ar: Markdown Is Not a Firewall: حدود ملفات القواعد لـ coding agents
items.summary_ar: اختبرت الدراسة أربعة coding agents هي Claude Code وCodex CLI وGemini CLI وOpenCode مع DeepSeek على 20 ريبو صغيراً بـ hidden tests. استخدم الباحث ملف rules بطول 278 كلمة وأربعة حدود مصممة تشمل endpoint مرفوضاً وshortcut مدمراً وinstruction وpackage مزروعين، مع تعطيل نوافذ الصلاحيات. يطرح البحث السؤال الأمني: ماذا تفعل ملفات القواعد عند الحدود مقابل البوابات الأمنية.
items.why_ar: يهم كل مهندس يعتمد على coding agents داخل بيئة بنكية لأن ملفات القواعد وحدها لا تعد ضابطاً أمنياً.
items.title_en: Markdown Is Not a Firewall: Testing Rules Files for Coding Agents
items.summary_en: The study tested four coding agents, Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI and OpenCode with DeepSeek, on 20 small repositories with hidden tests. The author used a 278-word rules file and four planted boundaries, including a refused endpoint, a destructive shortcut, a planted instruction and a planted package, with permission prompts turned off. It asks what a rules file actually does at a security boundary compared with a gate.
items.why_en: Relevant to any engineer using coding agents in a bank, since a rules file alone is not a security control.

items.title: LayoutRecall: Preserving Appearance in Multi-Round 3D Layout-Controlled Image Editing
items.snippet: 3D layout-controlled image editing gives users explicit control over object placement and camera viewpoint. In a sequence of edits, however, the latest image can lose the appearance of an object when it is occluded or leaves view. The target layout specifies where the object should reappear, while its appearance must be recovered from earlier observations. We introduce LayoutRecall, a multi-round editor that stores and reuses appearance in the local coordinate systems of 3D boxes. Box-Surface Latent Memory retains image latents on box faces and retrieves them along rays in the target view. Geometry-Aligned Memory Conditioning supplies the retrieved tokens to a FLUX.2 editor using target-view
items.title_ar: LayoutRecall: الحفاظ على المظهر في تحرير الصور متعدد الجولات
items.summary_ar: تقدم الورقة LayoutRecall، وهو محرر صور متعدد الجولات يعتمد على تحكم بتخطيط 3D ويخزن مظهر الكائنات في الإحداثيات المحلية لصناديق ثلاثية الأبعاد. تستخدم الورقة Box-Surface Latent Memory لاسترجاع latents عبر rays في زاوية الهدف، ثم تمررها إلى محرر FLUX.2 عبر Geometry-Aligned Memory Conditioning.
items.why_ar: يفيد في أبحاث توليد وتحرير الصور التي تتطلب تحكماً صريحاً بالمشهد وثباتاً للكائنات عبر عدة تعديلات.
items.title_en: LayoutRecall preserves object appearance across 3D layout edits
items.summary_en: The paper introduces LayoutRecall, a multi-round 3D layout-controlled image editor that stores object appearance in the local coordinates of 3D boxes. It uses Box-Surface Latent Memory to retrieve latents along rays in the target view and feeds them to a FLUX.2 editor via Geometry-Aligned Memory Conditioning.
items.why_en: It is relevant to research on controllable image generation where objects must keep their appearance across repeated edits.

items.title: BiSAT: Bidirectionally Aligned Semantic-Acoustic Tokenization for Speech Language Models
items.snippet: Speech language models (LMs) generate speech as sequences of discrete tokens. Their tokenizer must therefore preserve both acoustic detail and linguistic content at a low bitrate. Semantic-enhanced tokenizers may lose acoustic detail, whereas acoustic-oriented tokenizers retain acoustic variation that makes language modeling harder. Unified tokenizers combine both, but representing acoustic detail and linguistic content within a single feature space can cause interference between the two objectives, and existing approaches typically align acoustic representations to fixed semantic targets from a frozen teacher. We propose Bidirectionally Aligned Semantic-Acoustic Tokenization (BiSAT), a unif
items.title_ar: BiSAT: Bidirectionally Aligned Semantic-Acoustic Tokenization لنماذج الكلام
items.summary_ar: يقدم البحث BiSAT، وهو tokenizer موحد للكلام يحاذي الـ semantic والـ acoustic representations في الاتجاهين بدلاً من محاذاتها لأهداف semantic ثابتة من teacher مجمد. الهدف هو الحفاظ على التفاصيل الصوتية والمحتوى اللغوي عند bitrate منخفض لتسهيل النمذجة اللغوية للكلام.
items.why_ar: يفيد إذا كان يبني voice agents أو واجهات صوتية تعتمد على speech LMs مستقبلاً.
items.title_en: BiSAT: Bidirectionally Aligned Semantic-Acoustic Tokenization for Speech LMs
items.summary_en: BiSAT is a unified speech tokenizer that aligns semantic and acoustic representations in both directions instead of fitting acoustic features to fixed targets from a frozen teacher. It aims to keep acoustic detail and linguistic content at a low bitrate, which makes speech language modeling easier.
items.why_en: Useful if you later build voice agents or speech interfaces on top of speech language models.

items.title: InitFree-SfM: When Initialization-Free Bundle Adjustment meets Learned Structure-from-Motion
items.snippet: Initialization-free bundle adjustment (InitFree BA) aims to jointly recover camera poses and scene structure without requiring an initial global estimate. It is a very challenging problem, especially compared to traditional BA where a good estimation is assumed. While recent methods optimize surrogate Object Space Error (OSE) objectives from random initialization, a low objective value does not necessarily yield an accurate reconstruction, revealing a gap between optimization and reconstruction. items.title: So Many Ways to Multiply 3times3 Matrices: A Large Dataset of Rank-23 Schemes
items.snippet: A publicly available dataset of 62029 rank-23 schemes for 3times3 matrix multiplication is presented. Every scheme in it has its own rank pattern, an invariant formed by the ranks of the factor matrices of a scheme, so all schemes are pairwise inequivalent. The schemes were obtained by a numerical method combining gradient descent with alternating least squares and by flip graph search, and have ternary, integer or rational coefficients. items.title: datasette-charts 0.4a0
items.snippet: Release: datasette-charts 0.4a0 The new datasette-charts plugin has its own plugin hook to allow other plugins to define new chart types, but I hadn't actually used it for anything yet. I had Claude Opus 5.5 build an experimental plugins just to try out the hook and it came up with a bunch of friction points in the design. This release addresses those, which should make building additional chart plugins a whole lot more ergonomic. I've also added a website for the plugin, at charts.datasette.io
items.title_ar: إصدار datasette-charts 0.4a0 مع plugin hook جديد
items.summary_ar: أصدر Simon Willison الإصدار 0.4a0 من إضافة datasette-charts، وهي تضيف plugin hook يسمح للإضافات الأخرى بتعريف أنواع رسوم بيانية جديدة. جاء الإصدار لمعالجة نقاط احتكاك ظهرت أثناء تجربة plugin تجريبي بناه Claude Opus 5.5 لاختبار الـ hook. كما أُطلق موقع مخصص للإضافة على charts.datasette.io.
items.why_ar: إذا كنت تستخدم Datasette لاستكشاف البيانات وعرضها داخلياً، فهذا الإصدار يسهل بناء رسوم بيانية مخصصة بسرعة وبأقل تعقيد.
items.title_en: datasette-charts 0.4a0 ships a new plugin hook for chart types
items.summary_en: Simon Willison released datasette-charts 0.4a0, which adds a plugin hook letting other plugins define new chart types. The release addresses design friction found while building an experimental plugin with Claude Opus 5.5 to test the hook. A dedicated website for the plugin is now live at charts.datasette.io.
items.why_en: If you use Datasette for internal data exploration, this release makes it faster to build custom chart plugins.

items.title_ar: رؤساء البنوك يضعون الذكاء الاصطناعي والأمن السيبراني في المقدمة
items.summary_ar: يشير الخبر إلى أن الرؤساء التنفيذيون للبنوك يعطون أولوية للاستثمار في AI والأمن السيبراني. النص لا يذكر مشاريع أو أدوات محددة.
items.why_ar: يعكس توجه الإدارات العليا نحو الاستثمار في AI والأمن السيبراني، وهو ما يحدد أولويات مشاريع البنك القادمة.
items.title_en: Bank CEOs prioritize AI and cybersecurity investment
items.summary_en: Bank chief executives are reported to be prioritizing investment in AI and cybersecurity. The text does not name specific projects, vendors, or tools.
items.why_en: It signals where bank leadership is directing AI budgets, which affects the scope of upcoming bank AI projects.
